newsitem.title: CHINA: China's Xinda reports capital of 10.8 bln yuan.
newsitem.headline: China's Xinda reports capital of 10.8 bln yuan.

text.p: The China Xinda Trust and Investment Co reported total capital of 10.8 billion yuan ($1.3 billion) at the end of 1996, the Securities Daily said on Friday.
Xinda, formerly the China Construction Bank Trust and Investment Co, also reported a capital profit ratio of 20 percent, while the profit ratio on assets was about one percent, the newspaper said.
Xinda's trust business accounted for 61 percent of the company's total assets by the end of last year, the newspaper said.
The company's total equities turnover reached 95.8 billion yuan, of which treasury bills accounted for 30.9 billion yuan and stocks made up 12.9 billion yuan.
The newspaper did not give comparative figures.

Xinda was rechristened as part of a drive to separate the trust and investment firms affiliated with China's four largest state banks from their powerful backers, although they remain wholly owned bank subsidiaries.
